name: PBX Elite WhatsApp Userbot
description: PBX Elite — single-session WhatsApp userbot (Go + whatsmeow + MongoDB) with a web pairing page.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection URL (used for AFK, sudo, PM security, etc.)

OWNER_JID.description: Your WhatsApp number, digits only with country code (e.g. 919646191598). The website only pairs this number.

PAIR_KEY.description: Optional access key for the pairing website (stops strangers from using the pair page).

ALLOW_ANY_NUMBER.description: Set to true to allow pairing a number different from OWNER_JID.

GOFLAGS.description: Keep as -mod=mod (lets Heroku fetch the Go modules on first build).

MEDIA_API_URL.description: Base URL of your media download API (leave blank to use the default endpoint).

MEDIA_API_KEY2.description: Backup media download API key (used if MEDIA_API_KEY is not set).
